title: Stage mapping from change events

story.i_want_to: move a story's stage from its change's events
story.so_that: the stage machine reflects landing, deploy and revert without a PR stage

rationale: PRD §5 mapping table. Reuses existing stages; adds two control-only edges.

acceptance_criteria.description: submitted moves implementing to reviewing; review_findings moves reviewing to implementing over :review_findings; check_passed with an approved review moves reviewing to ci; landed moves ci to merged with merge_sha set to the landing commit; deployed moves merged to deployed.
verified records trunk_verified_sha on the stage row and writes no edge.
A new control-only edge :reverted takes merged or deployed to implementing, keeping the claim; it is not runner-reportable and is distinct from :merge_refused.
An event whose edge the machine does not allow from the row's current stage escalates over a new control-only edge :change_outside_lifecycle and records the event; it never forces the stage.
pr_open is never entered for a story whose intake source is mode: :chg.

test_cases.name: happy path
steps: apply submitted, check_passed + approval, landed, deployed

technical_notes: Both edges go in @transitions in lib/loopctl/delivery/stage_machine.ex and stay out of the runner allowlist.
Ask what writes the edge out of every stage a new writer leaves stories in (the stage_machine.ex comment on absorbing stages).
